items.title: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Tops Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: ADP (ADP) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.93% and +0.87%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: ADP’s (NASDAQ:ADP) Q2 CY2026 Sales Beat Estimates
items.summary: Payroll and HR services provider Automatic Data Processing (NASDAQ:ADP) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 6.8% year on year to $5.47 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.64 per share was 1.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: ADP Targets More Gains Ahead After Quarterly Growth
items.summary: Automatic Data Processing said its revenue and earnings should keep rising in fiscal 2027 after its latest completed quarter saw growth in both its employer services and human resources outsourcing businesses.

items.title: ADP (ADP) Reports Earnings Tomorrow: What To Expect
items.summary: Payroll and HR services provider Automatic Data Processing (NASDAQ:ADP) will be announcing earnings results this Wednesday before market hours. Here’s what you need to know.

items.title: INTU Down 60%: Is Intuit's Proven Price Floor About To Break?
items.summary: The software giant behind TurboTax has fallen back to a price floor that has launched major rallies before, but a new crack in its business model is testing investors’ faith.

items.title: ADP AI legal chief: CFOs take a ‘human in the loop’ approach
items.summary: “We all know that AI can look very polished and persuasive,” but human judgment is important, ADP’s chief legal AI officer Helena Almeida says.

items.title: ADP Gears Up to Report Q4 Earnings: What's Next for Investors?
items.summary: ADP heads into the Q4 earnings release with revenues expected to rise 5.9% and EPS likely to grow 14.6%, fueled by segment gains and client funds growth.
